################################################################################
Purpose of script: To fit brms models to all the studies
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_add_new_expression.R")
source("fun_formulas.R")
dirs$outputs <- "../outputs/modfit"
```

# Define the pathogen data frame with 'doses' and 'others' columns
```{r}
# Define the pathogen data frame with 'doses' and 'others' columns
patmono_df <- data.frame(
  pat = c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "hib", 
          "ipv", "ipv2", "ipv3", "opv", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "pertufha", "pertuprn", "hbv")) %>%
  mutate(
    doses = case_when(pat %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav") ~ "d1", TRUE ~ "d3"),
    others = case_when(
      pat %in% c("dipht") ~ list(c("vac_conc", "vac_name_v1", "(1|study)",
                                   "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "men", "hib", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", 
                 "pertu", "pertufha", "pertuprn", "strep") ~ list(c("vac_conc", "(1|study)", 
                                            "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("polio") ~ list(c("vac_name_v1", "(1|study)", "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("ipv", "ipv2", "ipv3", "opv", "hbv") ~ list(c("(1|study)", "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("hav") ~ list(c("(1|country)", "(1|country:center:rct_group)")),
      TRUE ~ list(NULL)))
```

# MVN Define the pathogen data frame with 'doses' and 'others' columns
```{r}
patmulti_df <- data.frame(
  pat = c("multi_men", "multi_strep", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv", "multi_pertu",
          "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_hib-men", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv")) %>%
  mutate(
    doses = case_when(pat %in% c("multi_mmr-vzv", "multi_mmr") ~ "d1", TRUE ~ "d3"),
    others = case_when(
      # pat %in% c("multi_strep") ~ list(c("vac_conc", "vac_name_v1", "(1|study)",
      #                                    "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("multi_men", "multi_pertu", "multi_strep") ~ list(c("vac_conc", "(1|study)",
                                                      "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("multi_polio", "multi_dtp") ~ list(c("vac_name_v1", "(1|study)",
                                                    "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      pat %in% c("multi_dtpa", "multi_hib-men") ~ list(c("(1|study)")),
      pat %in% c("multi_ipv", "multi_opv", "multi_dtpw", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv") ~ 
        list(c("(1|study)", "(1|study:country:center:rct_group)")),
      TRUE ~ list(NULL))) %>%
  rowwise() %>%  # Ensure operations happen row by row
  mutate(multi_pat = list(readRDS(glue(
    "{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pat}_{case_when(doses == 'd1' ~ 'v1', .default = 'vl')}_s08.rds")) %>%
      names() %>%
      str_subset("imm_val_s1") %>%
      str_remove("imm_val_s1_"))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Photoperiod models ===============================================================================

# Define cluster variable names
```{r}
cluster_varnames <- c("reg_6", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2")

# Define the models and varnames
mod_photo_df <- expand_grid(
  model_nm = c("csi"),
  varname = c("reg_6", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2")
) %>%
  add_row(model_nm = "base", varname = "") %>%
  add_row(model_nm = "cs", varname = "") %>%
  arrange(model_nm)

# Combine the pathogen data with the model-varname combinations
patmono_photo_df <- expand_grid(patmono_df, mod_photo_df)
patmono_photo_df

patmulti_photo_df <- expand_grid(patmulti_df, mod_photo_df)
patmulti_photo_df
```

# Univariate models: Create list of formulas and save them 
```{r}
patmono_photo_formula_l <- sapply(unique(patmono_photo_df$pat), function(x) {
  l_formula <- list()
  for (i in which(patmono_photo_df$pat == x)) {
    l_formula <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula, fun_formulas(
        pathogen = patmono_photo_df[i,"pat"][[1]], 
        data = "s08", 
        doses = patmono_photo_df[i,"doses"][[1]], 
        model_nm = patmono_photo_df[i,"model_nm"][[1]], 
        others = patmono_photo_df[i,"others"][[1]][[1]],
        varname = patmono_photo_df[i,"varname"][[1]]))}
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{x}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

# Multivariate models: Create list of formulas and save them 
```{r}
patmulti_photo_formula_l <- sapply(unique(patmulti_photo_df$pat), function(x) {
  l_formula <- list()
  for (i in which(patmulti_photo_df$pat == x)) {
    l_formula <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula, fun_formulas_multipathogen(
        pathogen = patmulti_photo_df[i,"pat"][[1]], 
        data = "s08", 
        doses = patmulti_photo_df[i,"doses"][[1]], 
        model_nm = patmulti_photo_df[i,"model_nm"][[1]], 
        others = patmulti_photo_df[i,"others"][[1]][[1]],
        varname = patmulti_photo_df[i,"varname"][[1]],
        multi_pat = patmulti_photo_df[i,"multi_pat"][[1]][[1]]
        ))}
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{x}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}, simplify = FALSE)

patmulti_photo_formula_l$multi_dtpa
```

# Photoperiod and climate models ===================================================================
 
# Read in cluster variable names
```{r}
mod_phoreg_df <- expand_grid(
  dat = c("s08_dfkgc1", "s08_dfkgc2", "s08_dfkgc3"),
  model_nm = c("cs2i"),
  varname = c("reg_6", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2"),
  varname2 = c("kgc_1", "kgc_2", "kgc_3")
) %>%
  filter((dat == "s08_dfkgc1" & varname2 == "kgc_1") |
         (dat == "s08_dfkgc2" & varname2 %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2")) |
         (dat == "s08_dfkgc3" & varname2 %in% c("kgc_1", "kgc_2", "kgc_3"))) %>%
  arrange(dat, varname, varname2)

# Combine the pathogen data with the model-varname combinations
patmono_phoreg_df <- expand_grid(patmono_df, mod_phoreg_df)
patmono_phoreg_df

patmulti_phoreg_df <- expand_grid(patmulti_df, mod_phoreg_df)
patmulti_phoreg_df
```

# Step 1. Univariate models: Check convergence of the photoperiod and climate models 
```{r}
patmono_phoreg_formula_l <- sapply(unique(patmono_phoreg_df$pat), function(x) {
  l_formula <- list()
  for (i in which(patmono_phoreg_df$pat == x)) {
    l_formula <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula, fun_formulas(
        pathogen = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"pat"][[1]], 
        data = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"dat"][[1]], 
        doses = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"doses"][[1]], 
        model_nm = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"model_nm"][[1]], 
        others = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"others"][[1]][[1]],
        varname = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"varname"][[1]],
        varname2 = patmono_phoreg_df[i,"varname2"][[1]],
        ), omit_exp = TRUE)}
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{x}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}, simplify = FALSE)

patmono_phoreg_formula_l$rota
```

# Step 2. Univariate models: Run base models once convergence is checked 
converging:
kgc_3 dipht, dtpa, polio, rota, 
kgc_1 hbv, strep, men
kgc_2 hib, ipv, pertu
```{r}
# Add the converging data frame to the pathogen data with the model-varname combinations
patmono_phoregbase_df <- patmono_photo_df %>%
  mutate(dat = case_when(pat %in% c("hbv", "strep", "men") ~ "s08_dfkgc1",
                         pat %in% c("hib", "ipv", "pertu") ~ "s08_dfkgc2",
                         pat %in% c("dipht", "dtpa", "rota", "polio") ~ "s08_dfkgc3")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dat))

patmono_phoregbase_formula_l <- sapply(unique(patmono_phoregbase_df$pat), function(x) {
  l_formula <- list()
  for (i in which(patmono_phoregbase_df$pat == x)) {
    l_formula <- add_new_expression(
      l_formula, fun_formulas(
        pathogen = patmono_phoregbase_df[i,"pat"][[1]], 
        data = patmono_phoregbase_df[i,"dat"][[1]], 
        doses = patmono_phoregbase_df[i,"doses"][[1]], 
        model_nm = patmono_phoregbase_df[i,"model_nm"][[1]], 
        others = patmono_phoregbase_df[i,"others"][[1]][[1]],
        varname = patmono_phoregbase_df[i,"varname"][[1]]), omit_exp = TRUE)}
  saveRDS(l_formula, file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{x}_l.rds"))
  return(l_formula)
}, simplify = FALSE)

patmono_phoregbase_formula_l$rota
```
